# Working sawtooth program fresh

# soft reset
write: 0xF8 0x90 0x00 0x00 
write: 0xF8 0x90 0x00 0x01 
# hibernate
write: 0xF4 0x00 0x00 0x00 
write: 0xF4 0x00 0x00 0x01 
# kill core
write: 0xF4 0x03 0x00 0x00 
write: 0xF4 0x03 0x00 0x01 
# pll enable
write: 0xF0 0x03 0x00 0x00 
# pll control 0
write: 0xF0 0x00 0x00 0x60 
# pll control 1
write: 0xF0 0x01 0x00 0x02 
# pll clk src
write: 0xF0 0x02 0x00 0x01 
# mclk out
write: 0xF0 0x05 0x00 0x05 
# pll enable
write: 0xF0 0x03 0x00 0x01 

# sleep?

# power enable
write: 0xF0 0x50 0x1F 0xFF 
write: 0xF0 0x51 0x00 0x1F 

# ?
write: 0xFB 0x4E 0x00 0x07
write: 0xF7 0x9E 0x00 0x0F 
write: 0xF7 0x9F 0x00 0x0F 
write: 0xF7 0xA0 0x00 0x0F
